'''2018 U.S. National Championship''' was the Players Committee U.S. National Championship, 27–29 July 2018. [[Tom Haid]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' United States
* '''Dates:''' 27–29 July 2018
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Haid]]
